provenance.input: installations with function EF_25 (barriers), all scopes
provenance.rule: welded connected components that are vertical prisms (every vertex on the lowest or highest level, same xy set at both, vertical triangle area = hull perimeter x height), listed when >= 1.5 m tall, hull diameter <= 3.0 m and, for rectangles and circles, smaller side >= 0.15 m. No per-column object or class exists in the data, so this is geometry, not a PLATEAU classification.
provenance.kit_rule: square or round, 0.40 to 1.00 m, rectangles up to 1:1.6, height >= 1.96 m; sleeve scaled from the 0.61 m x 2.8 m piece
provenance.finish: The kit column's finish is generic Lane E art (tile or enamel body), not a survey of the Ikebukuro columns.

frame.axes: ENU metres: x east, y north, z TP height
frame.rotation_deg: counter-clockwise from +X seen from above, of the `width` axis (square: 0 to 90, rect: 0 to 180, round: 0)
